examples.arabic: كل يوم بنصحى بدري عشان نخطط للفرح الكبير
examples.english: Every day we wake up early to plan for the big wedding.
examples.transliteration: Koll yōm bansaa badry ʿashān nokhaṭṭeṭ lel-faraḥ el-kabīr.

examples.english: Layla woke up early this morning.
examples.transliteration: Sehet Layla badri ennaharda el sobh.

examples.arabic: في أول يوم العيد، صحينا بدري ولبسنا هدومنا الجديدة.
examples.english: On the first day of Eid, we woke up early and put on our new clothes.
examples.transliteration: fe awel yom el eid, sehena badry wa lebesna hodomna el gedida.
examples.storyTitle: The Joy of Eid with the Family

examples.english: My brother works early and left quickly.
examples.transliteration: Akhouya biyeshtaghal badry we meshy bsoraa.

examples.english: Today is my birthday and I woke up early.
examples.transliteration: el naharda eed miladi wa seheet badri

examples.english: I wake up early every day.
